uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Reduces the duration of hindrances inflicted on Kubfu by 15%.
Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage.
Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage.

The user receives 20% reduced damage as they charge power for up to 2s, increasing power levels until reaching maximum charge after 1s; then punches in the designated direction when released, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. If this move is canceled or not released after 2s, it goes on a 0.9s cooldown.

The user becomes unstoppable, receives 20% reduced damage and decreases their movement speed by 30% as they charge power for up to 2.5s, becoming charged after 1s; then strikes in the designated direction with a fierce blow when released, readying a boosted attack if it hits. When uncharged, the cooldown of this move is reduced by 50%; and the user strikes in a small line area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed when it hits. When charged, the user strikes in a larger cone area of effect, dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon and dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit. Opposing Pokémon in the center line area of effect receive a critical hit and are shoved. If this move is canceled or not released after 2.5s, it goes on a 2.1s cooldown. Damage is always a critical and deals additional damage equal to 14% of the enemies missing HP. Against Wild Pokemon: This additional damage is capped at 1200. Deals additional damage equal to 7% of the enemies' missing HP. Against Wild Pokemon: This additional damage is capped at 600.
Strengthens damage reduction while charging this move to 40%. If this move is charged when released, opposing Pokémon in the center line area of effect are also stunned with the shove.

The user dashes forward and strikes with a flowing motion, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. This move can be used up to two more times within 4s of the previous use. Opposing Pokémon hit by the third use receive a critical hit and are thrown. Each time this move is used, the user readies an enhanced boosted attack which restores the user's HP per hit. 2% max HP
Receives 30% reduced damage while using this move.
The user dashes forward with a headbutt, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving them when it hits.

The user readies a boosted attack and dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and stunning them for 0.7s when it hits. Dash in the designated direction and strike with a flowing motion, dealing damage to enemies hit. This move can be used an additional two times and the third time it is used, any hits are always critical hits and the enemy is thrown. Urshifu's next basic attack after using this move becomes a boosted attack and if the boosted attack hits, Urshifu's HP is restored.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 40% of its remaining cooldown when Wicked Blow hits.

The user stomps the ground, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon and decreasing their Defense by 30% for 3s; and granting the user a shield for 3s if it hits, strengthening per opposing Pokémon hit (up to 3 times). Deal damage to and decrease the defense of enemies in the area around Urshifu by 30% for 2s. When this move hits, Urshifu is granted a shield whose strength is based on the number of enemies hit.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.

The user becomes unstoppable and the cooldown of Wicked Blow is reset when this Unite Move is used. The user dashes at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, stunning them, then chooses whether to designate a direction to move or not. If no direction is chosen, the user pushes them slightly and delivers an uppercut, damaging the target, throwing them and stunning them when they land. If the user chooses a direction, the user instead delivers a more powerful blow to the target, dealing increased damage and shoving them in the designated direction. The shoved target also deals reduced damage to opposing Pokémon they collide with and throws those hit.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

The user activates the Flowing Fists buff for up to 10s, and briefly becomes unstoppable and damages nearby opposing Pokémon, shoving them away. If this Unite Move is used again, the user becomes unstoppable and receives 30% reduced damage as they unleash a minimum of 5 consecutive blows upon the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and shoving them with each hit. After the consecutive blows have finished, the user delivers a final kick, damaging opposing Pokémon in front of themself and shoving them when it hits. When the Flowing Fists buff is active, until the follow-up attack is used, every 2 times the user hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the number of consecutive blows for the follow-up attack increases by 1 (up to 10 hits for an additional 5 blows; maximum 10 consecutive blows).
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

If no direction is chosen, the user pushes them slightly and delivers an uppercut, damaging the target, throwing them and stunning them when they land. If the user chooses a direction, the user instead delivers a more powerful blow to the target, dealing increased damage and shoving them in the designated direction. The shoved target also deals reduced damage to opposing Pokémon they collide with and throws those hit.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Ebon Fist は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、相手を押し出す、妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する。

source.name: Flowing Fists
source.originalDescription: The user activates the Flowing Fists buff for up to 10s, and briefly becomes unstoppable and damages nearby opposing Pokémon, shoving them away. If this Unite Move is used again, the user becomes unstoppable and receives 30% reduced damage as they unleash a minimum of 5 consecutive blows upon the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and shoving them with each hit. After the consecutive blows have finished, the user delivers a final kick, damaging opposing Pokémon in front of themself and shoving them when it hits. When the Flowing Fists buff is active, until the follow-up attack is used, every 2 times the user hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the number of consecutive blows for the follow-up attack increases by 1 (up to 10 hits for an additional 5 blows; maximum 10 consecutive blows).
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Flowing Fists は 妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
